headline: Türkiye conducted 72.2 billion dollars of trade with OTS members in 5 years
summary: Türkiye's mutual trade with Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan totalled $72.2 billion over five years. Cooperation is deepening in areas including free zones and artificial intelligence.
why: Trade with regional partners shapes Türkiye's export markets and the economic ties that influence its external accounts.
